scientific_question: Does the cue/video-deconfounded stimulus-specific imagery reliability observed in C3XAT-R1 replicate in INDEPENDENT participants/data, and can increased independent measurement PRECISION distinguish reproducible imagery signal from cue/video contamination without subject selection?
independence_rule: primary replication data must NOT have been used in C3XC/C3XD/C3XDR/C3XDR-R1/C3XAT/C3XAT-R1; ds005191 usable only for method validation/replay/synthetic calibration/precision planning
participant_eligibility: all prospectively eligible subjects enter the fixed denominator; ordinary technical MRI QC only; NO responder enrichment; NO selection by imagery ability/vividness/prior R_I/Delta/decoding/ROI signal; must NOT target sub-02 or sub-03
stimulus_identity_contract: fixed naturalistic identities (>=72 target) repeated once per imagery unit; >=50 distinct identities minimum
perception_contract: each perception independent unit contains the SAME complete identity set; NO coverage-optimized or outcome-driven pairing
roi: WANG25_TOPOGRAPHIC_VISUAL_NETWORK (Wang2015 ProbAtlas_v4 3743ac34...; mask 19b681ec...); NO performance-defined or localizer ROI for the PRIMARY endpoint
preprocessing: inherit fMRIPrep 24.1.1 sha256 9aec0b83... -> MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2mm, no smoothing
GLM: MODEL_A_LSA (bit-identical C3XD): per-trial cue/imagery/post-video + grouped real-eval + frozen nuisance
nuisance: motion6 required; csf/white_matter if present; all cosine drift; run/session intercept
R_I: Spearman-Brown corrected session/block-disjoint split-half reliability; frozen c3xb estimator
R_P: matched fixed-content reliability; complete-identity unit; frozen c3xb estimator
Delta: R_I_observed - R_I_contamination_predicted; contamination carries EXACTLY zero true-imagery; conservative PAIRED sensitivity (Delta>0 point AND paired boot CI lower>0 AND Delta>0 every seed); rejected fixed-R_pred permutation NOT restored
subject_PASS: imagery R_I PASS AND matched R_P PASS AND cue/post-stimulus Delta PASS AND unit contract PASS AND atlas QC PASS
cohort_gate: required_passes = max(2, ceil(N/3)) over the FIXED eligible denominator (inherits C3XAT 2/6=one-third); >=req -> C3XRP_REPLICATION_QUALIFIED; 0<pass<req -> LIMITED; 0 with complete valid -> FAIL; incomplete/invalid -> C3XRP_BLOCKED_*

spatial_specificity_endpoint.status: SECONDARY unless prospectively promoted before any outcome

negative_controls: inherit C3XAT (within-unit content-label permutation null; cue/post-video forward-contamination; size-matched random cortex)
